name: Krishnanagar

queries.query: Krishnanagar Nadia West Bengal municipal holding property assessment cadastral map official
queries.result: Krishnanagar Municipality runs a city-specific holding-tax due service by ward, road and holding number. Municipal service documentation describes assessment of new holdings and certified copies. No cadastral parcel viewer or vector layer was found.

queries.result: কৃষ্ণনগর পৌরসভার নিজস্ব পোর্টালে ওয়ার্ড, রাস্তা ও হোল্ডিং নম্বর দিয়ে করের বকেয়া যাচাই করা যায়। পৌর পরিষেবা নথিতে নতুন হোল্ডিংয়ের মূল্যায়ন ও প্রত্যয়িত কপির কথা আছে। কেডাস্ট্রাল পার্সেল মানচিত্র বা ভেক্টর সেবা পাওয়া যায়নি।

portals.observation: Official municipality-linked public due-check shell exposes ward, road-name and holding-number selectors; no holding lookup was performed and no property data were retrieved.
Municipality website identifies Krishnanagar Municipality and links public payment/service sections.
Government of West Bengal UDMA directory identifies Krishnanagar Municipality in Nadia district.
West Bengal UDMA municipal order discusses Krishnanagar municipal service and property-tax collection; it records operational concerns and does not establish cadastral vector availability.

Official West Bengal land-record portal lists RS-LR plot information and plot/mouza map request services behind citizen-service login. Shell retrieval timed out locally; this is not treated as an origin failure and no login was attempted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Krishnanagar Municipality’s local holding-tax service identifies wards, road names and holding numbers, and its official municipal service charter describes assessment of new holdings and certified-copy services. This establishes local municipal holding/property-assessment records, not a cadastral land-title registry or vector map.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No public cadastral map or parcel geometry route was found. City-specific tax records are organized by holding but do not establish survey-boundary geometry or a title-registry map.
